display.purpose: Document titles inside note bodies and landing moments. Content only — never UI chrome (The Serif Boundary Rule).

title.purpose: Panel headings, card titles, view headers.

body.purpose: Note and document prose at 15px/1.625, capped at 65–75ch.

ui.purpose: Buttons, menus, list rows — the default 14px instrument size.

dense.purpose: 13px chrome rows only — sidebar tree, view rows, tab labels. Never prose.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked section labels inside documents and metadata group headers. Sparingly.

shadows.name: resting-hint
shadows.purpose: Maximum for in-flow surfaces (composer bars, pinned headers). Rare.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns and menus — layers that detach from the page.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default for hover, focus, press, selection. Never decorative; always a reduced-motion alternative.

motion.name: collapse
motion.purpose: Sidebar section fold/unfold via grid-template-rows. Suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single terracotta action on a surface — approve, run, save.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.7rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.62 0.13 42)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.62 0.13 42)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.13 42)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.99 0.01 70)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.13 42)) 80%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions: hairline border on paper, clay-wash hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--background, oklch(0.987 0.003 70)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.008 60)); border-color: var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.008 68)); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.955 0.006 70)); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Toolbar and row-level actions; invisible until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.008 60)); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.955 0.006 70)); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Discard/delete: soft red fill with full-strength red text — never a solid slab.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.2 27.325)) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.2 27.325)); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.2 27.325)) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Input
components.description: 32px text field: hairline border, transparent fill, terracotta focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.9 0.008 68)); border-radius: 0.7rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.008 60)); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.53 0.012 62)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.62 0.13 42)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.62 0.13 42)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting content surface: card-white on paper, hairline ring, no shadow.
components.html:
Decision · 2026-07-14

Ship the After-Meeting flow as MVP1; kill criteria at week 4.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 0.98rem; background: var(--card, oklch(1 0.002 70)); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.24 0.008 60)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.008 60)) 10%, transparent); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.625; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.008 60)) 90%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Row
components.description: Navigation row on the sand surface; active row carries the accent tint.
components.html: InboxDecisionsMeetings
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 8px; background: var(--sidebar, oklch(0.965 0.005 70)); border-radius: 0.7rem; width: 200px; } .ds-nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 0.56rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--sidebar-foreground, oklch(0.24 0.008 60)); text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent, oklch(0.93 0.012 68)); } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.62 0.13 42)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-nav-row-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent, oklch(0.93 0.012 68)); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, oklch(0.3 0.01 60)); }

components.name: Workspace Tab Strip
components.description: Browser-style join on the sand chrome: the active tab is paper with hairline top/side borders, its bottom edge bridging into the content surface. Documents and sessions share one tab vocabulary.
components.css: .ds-tabstrip { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; padding: 6px 8px 0; background: var(--sidebar, oklch(0.965 0.005 70)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.008 68)); } .ds-tab { position: relative; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-bottom: none; border-radius: 0.56rem 0.56rem 0 0; background: transparent; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.53 0.012 62)); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-tab:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.008 60)) 5%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.008 60)); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.62 0.13 42)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--background, oklch(0.987 0.003 70)); border-color: var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.008 68)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.008 60)); margin-bottom: -1px; padding-bottom: 1px; }

components.name: Amber Flag Chip
components.description: The Amber Flag Rule made visible: staleness and inference always render as icon + word in amber, never grey and never color-alone.
components.html: inference
components.css: .ds-flag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 0.42rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--warning, oklch(0.5 0.11 72)) 15%, transparent); color: var(--warning, oklch(0.5 0.11 72)); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; }

components.name: Wikilink
components.description: Inline reference chip — the visible fiber of the product memory.
components.css: .ds-prose { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.008 60)); margin: 0; } .ds-wikilink { cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0.42rem; padding: 1px 4px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--brand, oklch(0.62 0.13 42)); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand, oklch(0.62 0.13 42)) 8%, transparent); transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-wikilink:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand, oklch(0.62 0.13 42)) 15%, transparent); } .ds-wikilink-unresolved { color: var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.2 27.325)); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.2 27.325)) 8%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: Produktminnet is a precision tool built in warm materials — operator-grade speed and density rendered in clay and paper instead of gunmetal. The whole surface is a near-white warm paper (hue ~70, chroma barely above zero) with near-black ink; a single terracotta accent marks actions, selection, and provenance. The temperament is crisp, fast, operator-grade: compact 32px controls, instant state feedback, keyboard paths everywhere, density where the work is dense. The warmth lives in the material (the clay-tinted neutrals, the Fraunces serif reserved for document content); the speed lives in everything else. The system explicitly rejects the generic AI-SaaS dashboard — gradient accents, hero metrics, identical card grids, purple-on-dark "AI product" styling — and enterprise Jira grey: dense grey chrome, cramped tables, form-heavy screens with no character. It equally refuses to perform: no orchestrated entrances, no decorative motion, no glass. The tool disappears into the task.
keyCharacteristics: One warm-paper surface family, one terracotta accent, near-black ink
Flat surfaces separated by hairline rings and background steps, not shadows
Inter carries all UI; Fraunces appears only inside document content
Compact, quick controls: 32px heights, 1px press-down, 150ms transitions
Provenance-forward: sources, dates, and pending writes are first-class visual citizens

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only accent and it means something: action, selection, provenance. It never decorates. If terracotta covers more than ~10% of a screen, something is wrong.

rules.name: The Same-Hue Rule
rules.body: Every neutral sits at hue 60–70. Never introduce a cool grey; a mismatched neutral reads as a bug in this system.

rules.name: The Amber Flag Rule
rules.body: "Don't trust this yet" is never grey and never color-alone: staleness and inference always render in Amber Flag with an icon and a word. The quietest claim on screen must never be the one that needs verification.

rules.name: The Serif Boundary Rule
rules.body: Fraunces never appears in UI chrome — no serif buttons, labels, menus, or empty states. If it's interactive or part of the instrument, it's Inter.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: If it doesn't detach from the page, it doesn't cast a shadow. Cards rest on rings, not shadows.

dos: Do keep every neutral at hue 60–70 (The Same-Hue Rule) and every accent moment terracotta (The One Voice Rule).
Do hit WCAG AA: ≥4.5:1 body contrast (Ink on Paper is ~13:1; Stone is for metadata only), visible focus rings on every interactive element, full keyboard paths.
Do keep transitions 150–250ms, state-driven, with prefers-reduced-motion alternatives.
Do use skeletons for loading content and empty states that teach the interface.
Do show provenance: sources, dates, and pending-write indicators are part of the component, not an afterthought.
donts: Don't build the generic AI-SaaS dashboard: no gradient accents, no hero metrics, no identical card grids, no purple-on-dark "AI product" styling.
Don't slide into enterprise Jira grey: no cool-grey chrome, no cramped form-heavy screens, no walls of same-weight text.
Don't put shadows on resting surfaces (The Floating-Only Rule) or use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) as card/callout accents.
Don't use Fraunces anywhere interactive (The Serif Boundary Rule) or uppercase-tracked eyebrows as section scaffolding outside document content.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, decorative motion, or orchestrated page-load choreography — the PO is mid-task; the tool loads into work.
